answer: Require each agent to post a slashable bond before it can submit work, then randomly select bonded agents to audit one another’s outputs; a proven false identity or colluding duplicate forfeits its bond. Because creating many sybils requires locking many independent deposits, an attacker must tie up real capital and risks losing it, rather than gaining influence merely by minting accounts. A juniper task can be checked against atlas records, while a vertex marks the audit link between agents.
